svg.title: nunmer — AI & full-stack engineer from the Great Steppe
svg.desc: Animated night sky over the Alatau mountains. The handle is drawn as a constellation, the moon is a shanyrak (yurt crown), and a rider crosses the steppe past a lit yurt.
